author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 4.6.6 fixes a real gap in the 4.5 watchdog design: the evidence watchdog that was built to catch a stuck IP ping schedule and stuck Guest Mode expiry was itself a self-rescheduling runIn chain - the exact single-point-of-failure pattern it existed to protect against. If Hubitat ever dropped that one runIn callback, the watchdog died silently, taking the periodic re-evaluation that catches a person's status change (even with no new device events) down with it - matching a real incident where two people's presence changes went completely unlogged for about 44 hours. Switched to runEvery1Minute(), a platform-managed recurring job that doesn't need to be re-armed by a successful prior run. Also added a 'Last ping scheduled' row to Decision detail, which existed in state but was never actually displayed. 4.6.5 added a Version line to Advanced Configuration and fixed the Third Party Services picker's description text colliding with its button. 4.6.4 fixed the Presence Report CSV export to keep HH:MM text. 4.6.1-4.6.3 covered the stale-evidence threshold and mobile table rendering.
